notes.title: Game controls extended in SUPERVERSE Update #18
notes.content:
The 18th update of SUPERVERSE extends the options to maneuver the spaceship using a game controller and introduces one more way to play the game.

You can now use the D-Pad on a game controller to rotate the spaceship in a clockwise direction by pressing [b]RIGHT on the D-Pad[/b] and to rotate the spaceship in a counterclockwise direction by pressing [b]LEFT on the D-Pad[/b].

The Thruster can now be activated and precisely controlled by pressing the [b]Right Trigger (RT)[/b].

Using D-Pad for rotation and RT for controlling the speed of the spaceship matches the controls you can find in many racing games with top-down view. This also matches the controls you have when playing the game using a keyboard.

We shuffled the default buttons layout and the buttons for activating Primary and Secondary Weapon have been moved to [b]Right Bumper (RB)[/b] and [b]Left Bumper (LB)[/b].

The Shield can be activated by pressing the [b]Left Trigger (LT)[/b].

To summarize, you can now use the game controller to maneuver the spaceship using one of the following combinations:

[list]
[*][b]D-PAD LEFT / RIGHT[/b] for rotation and [b]RT[/b] for thrust
[*][b]LEFT THUMBSTICK[/b] for rotation and thrust combined
[*][b]RIGHT THUMBSTICK[/b] for rotation and [b]RT[/b] for thrust
[/list] 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/8481770abe4554087654b19880b62d68f14d438b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2][b]Update #18[/b] | 2021-06-14[/h2]
[list]
[h3]Added[/h3]
[*]Extended game controller usability: D-Pad Left / Right can be used for rotating the spaceship Counterclockwise / Clockwise.

[h3]Changed[/h3]
[*]Thrust control moved to Right Trigger (RT). 
[*]Shield control moved to Left Trigger (LT).
[*]Primary Weapon control moved to Right Bumper (RB).
[*]Secondary Weapon control moved to Left Bumper (LB).
[*]Settings menu options order changed.
[*]Localizations updated.
[/list]

notes.title: New Tutorial microverse in Update #14
notes.content:
The fourteenth update of your favorite SUPERVERSE game is the biggest update released so far. It includes many improvements, changes, performance optimizations, bug fixes, changes in the game balance, and the new game content. 

[h1]Tutorial[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/511b4d041c30fa9b7071a00fbd28db2418a060aa.gif[/img]

A new microverse to start from. The Tutorial will introduce the player to the foundations of the gameplay, the game mechanics and the game controls.

Once successfully completed, the tutorial will be left optional to play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/5979891a88a6bbefbd22721bf64d7f1a31f0ad22.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/386caf3aa51108a60987f33315db0043e15e7858.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/456f81bfd8a7d4b5abcf7ec551f48493d81c136c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/d1b7922b0fae074b1f309d6c1cb39539932729c5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/ae05b697bf06f7ca5de4974f5c04e24096959a08.png[/img]

[h1]More Settings[/h1]
We had to re-think the display Gamma functionality and implement it in a different fashion than it was done in the previous versions of the game. The new version of display Gamma runs well on all the displays. Gamma is now adjustable through [b]Settings > Video > Gamma[/b] option.

New [b]EXPERIMENTAL[/b] setting has been introduced, allowing you to turn the mesh-instancing feature. Mesh-instancing could increase the performance on some slower configurations. Turn it on using [b]Settings > Video > Mesh instancing[/b] option. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/4dc6873f0a6114315b6155de680ec0701139e142.gif[/img]

[b]Settings > Game > Enemy HUD visibility[/b] option allows you to change the way enemy ships are visually marked. The energy scale can be presented permanently over the enemy ship, or it can be presented only when the enemy ship has been hit and is low on energy.

[h1]Integration with Steam[/h1]
This is the first version of the game that links with Steam's library and makes calls to Steamworks API.

Opening Steam layer, by pressing SHIFT + TAB keys or a dedicated button on a game controller, will pause the game. Closing the layer will resume the game automatically.

More Steam related features will be introduced in the forthcoming updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/7d629166a0d98d3caa9be4bff40b77d258a9cd47.gif[/img]


[h1]Steam Summer Sale[/h1]
It's already hot. And SUPERVERSE offer during Steam Summer Sale is hot too:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1056170/SUPERVERSE/
[i][b]SUPERVERSE[/b] game is currently available in Early Access for [b]Windows[/b] and [b]Linux[/b] 
(through Steam Play and Proton). [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/3cb0daa3a3494324206cc4fc69ba692f15590ccb.gif[/img]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2][b]Update #14[/b] | 2020-07-02[/h2]
[list]
[h3]Added[/h3]
[*]The new Tutorial universe introduces the player to the gameplay, game mechanics and controls.
[*]Meteor shower in the background of the main menu on the first run of the game.
[*]The new version of display Gamma runs on all displays, adjustable through [b]Settings > Video > Gamma[/b] option.
[*]New [b]Settings > Game[/b] menu introduced.
[*][b]Settings > Game > Enemy HUD visibility: Constant[/b] option introduced, enabling easier spotting of enemy ships. Turned on by default.
[*]New EXPERIMENTAL [b]Settings > Video > Mesh instancing[/b] option added. Turned Off by default. Mesh instancing could increase the performance on slower configurations.
[*]Initial integration of Steamworks SDK added.
[*]Opening Steam layer (SHIFT + TAB) pauses the game, closing it continues the game.
[*]Sparks have been used for the first time in the new Tutorial universe.
[/list][list]
[h3]Changed[/h3]
[*]Game balance changed: all the players' ships are stronger now.
[*]Music playback improved in situations during scene changes.
[*]Weapon Upgrade item name is now displayed beside the item.
[*]Texts added and updated.
[*]Bigger logo in the main menu.
[*]More compact Settings > Video menu.
[/list][list]
[h3]Fixed[/h3]
[*]Shorter game startup time for at least 1.5 seconds. Removed unused texture files and materials, and reorganized pre-loading of game assets.
[*]Instant game quitting: The window now closes immediately and the music shuts down.
[*]Fixed menu to refresh in some situations.
[*]Fixed situation when a transparent material is not rendered at all.
[/list]

notes.title: SUPERVERSE - The roadmap
notes.content:
Hello fellow spacemen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/e46df18a55a805848747ae3cb9f3a2362fc194c4.jpg[/img]


Here is an overview of some of the new and exciting features and enhancements that we are working on, which will be added to SUPERVERSE game in the near future.

[h1]Extended Spaceship Selection[/h1]
The selection of spaceships will be extended to five distinct ships to choose from. As you already know, all of them feature a unique design, weapon capacity, speed and maneuverability. A new ship is coming soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/b42a6b5fa42f21578c74190edfe27f6d32dced7e.gif[/img]


[h1]New Universes[/h1]
More universes will be introduced in the future, allowing you to explore new and interesting worlds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/ae05b697bf06f7ca5de4974f5c04e24096959a08.png[/img]


[h1]Weapons Arsenal[/h1]
New weapons are awaiting in depths of space! Beyond trusty lasers, armor-piercing minigun, powerful particle cannon and devastating guided missiles we are soon introducing more tools of destruction to pick up and take to your co-op battle.

[h1]More Enemies[/h1]
You have already encountered a number of hostile AI throughout the game, but there are more dangers ahead. Lurking in shadows of giant ship derelicts and patroling vast asteroid fields, new threats await. More enemies to fight, stronger and tougher to beat. Keep your eyes open and blasters loaded and ready.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/2a725795a66198c5ab7ec36f9823d1bbf0b8e8cd.jpg[/img]


[h1]Saving Game Progression[/h1]
Game progress will be saved after each universe, easing difficulty and allowing for those short play sessions. Feel like some quick co-op shooting? Jump in, without need to fight throughout Superverse in one sitting.

[h1]Advanced Game and Video Settings[/h1]
We will introduce game difficulty settings, bringing fun gameplay for every skill level. So far, video settings were limited to just a few options, but soon will be upgraded to allow easier tweak of the game's performance and visuals.

[h1]Configurable Game Controls[/h1]
New controllers will be introduced in the future as well as easy ways to customize the controls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/7831f78fadd5b9517a8726e7b6bd987355f90aef.gif[/img]


You can re-configure the keyboard controls if you do not find the default setup to suit your hardware or playing habits. The same can be done to customize joypads, gamepads, joysticks, and other kinds of game controllers using Steam's controller configuration panel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/93fea496b2a922b5cc9373ba857149e3f7b5f573.jpg[/img]


[h1]Tutorial[/h1]
We are working on an introductory level, to make it easier for new players to get the basics of controls, movement and gameplay. All in a new microverse to start from. Once successfully completed, the tutorial will be left optional to play.

[h1]Localization in Additional Languages[/h1]
The game has the internationalization system already in place, allowing support for any number of languages in Latin and Cyrillic alphabets. Currently, English and Serbian (in both Latin and Cyrillic) can be found in the game.

Support for other types of alphabets, such are Asian (e.g. Japanese, Chinese) or Arabic will be considered in the future as well.

Once most of the text copy found in the game is finalized, the game will be translated to the most popular languages, e.g. Spanish, French, German, Russian, and more.

[h1]Help / Guide[/h1]
A written guide covering all the aspects of the game, the gameplay, hardware and software compatibility will be available.

[h1]Deeper Integration with Steam[/h1]
New Steam related features will be introduced in the future updates of the game. Achievements, leaderboards and more will be added soon.

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
Completing specific goals will be awarded, achievements will be unlocked. Those achievements will be visible on players' Steam profiles - so your friends would know if you managed to reach and enter the wormhole.

[h1]Score and Leaderbords[/h1]
The scoring system will be introduced soon in the upcoming updates. It will be accompanied by the leaderboards, allowing the players to compare themselves with their friends' results and globally. 

[h1]Music[/h1]
New soundtracks are coming and will be added to the upcoming versions of the game.

You can also obtain and listen to all the soundtracks featured in the game separately:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1242970/SUPERVERSE_Soundtrack/

[h1]Performance Optimizations[/h1]
Something we are regularly working on is making the game more performant in each new version we release. Since the release of SUPERVERSE in Early Access, we have sped up the game significantly and made it work on many different hardware and operating systems configurations.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
Another area that is constantly being improved: fewer bugs and better stability of the game. Recent builds have fixed many smaller and several major issues, resulting in a much stable game. This, of course, is not without your help. Thank you for your patience, comments and bug reports.

Still, no game is perfect. Just keep us informed about any issues you might experience, both technical and gameplay-wise.

[h1]Editor[/h1]
For the purposes of designing the game, besides the game and the graphical engine, we have developed the universe editor - a tool that we use to create all those beautiful worlds you can explore and play in.

We plan to open up the editor publically so that you and other players can create new worlds and share them with others.

[h1]Command Line[/h1]
The in-game command line is another useful tool we use in the everyday development of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/f71af9352c8411b2aadcf07c1de6b403804f9664.gif[/img]


... and the list of upcoming features does not end here.

[b]SUPERVERSE[/b] game is currently available in Early Access for [b]Windows[/b] and [b]Linux[/b] 
(through Steam Play and Proton). 

To start playing SUPERVERSE game buy it on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1056170/SUPERVERSE/

[i]*All the upcoming updates discussed in this article will be automatically installed when released.[/i]

notes.title: Update #12: Stability improvements - Part 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/df73cd3e1fd0e85d57a48b8c44f9f417f03435fa.jpg[/img]

May is the month of stability improvements. Update #12 fixes all the remaining issues that could cause the game to be unstable and eventually crash.

A detailed list of technical changes follows:

[h1][Update #12] 2020-05-20[/h1]
[h3]Fixed[/h3]
- Incorrect number of fragments of debris left after NPC Destroyer's destruction
- Turret's debris material inheritance
- Removed ability to configure Gamma, as it seems there is a bug in the underlining 3rd party system which could cause the game to crash on some computers.
- Additional check if the selected monitor is still valid, as it may have been disconnected in the meantime when changing fullscreen/window mode and screen resolution.
- Fixed and removed unnecessary collision detection between some objects
- Fixed trails destruction that could cause a crash on some occasions 
- Dynamic materials management

[h3]Added[/h3]
- Semi-automatic stress testing system


Big thank you for the players who supported us with detailed descriptions of issues and testing on their computers.

notes.title: Co-op Multiplayer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/1316714f4c0d4b1fa9f3fa2bf50d1b74d750a30b.jpg[/img]

Update #4 brings a highly anticipated [b]Local Co-op Multiplayer[/b] mode to SUPERVERSE game.

[b]How to play[/b]
Up to 4 players can play the game together on the same computer. 
In co-op game players are represented by distinctly colored HUD (blue, red, green and yellow) and P1 to P4 icons above spaceship.

[b]Joining the game[/b]
To play co-op, begin new game by selecting [b]Play[/b] from main menu, the same way you would start the game for single-player mode. Select the spaceship and game will launch as usual.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/4e8791fedec34484ca9444f728ae61348be206fe.jpg[/img]

Another player wishing to join the game should press [b]FIRE[/b] button on the game controller (typically the green 'A' button on Xbox compatible game controller) or on the keyboard (SPACE / ENTER / CTRL). This will bring up the spaceship selection screen. Player can select ship and color and join the game.

[b]Leaving the game[/b]
At any point player can leave the game and allow others to continue playing by pausing the game, entering the in-game menu and selecting [b]Leave game P2[/b] (where P2 refers to player who will leave the game). 

[b]Respawning[/b]
In case the player's spaceship gets destroyed, its core AI program will be preserved in the [b]Spirit[/b] pod. Other players may continue playing, but they may also choose to resurrect their companion by salvaging spirit pod. This will respawn spaceship and put it back in action. When level is successful finished all players will again respawn in next one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/3e4f4aa94a8f2eb7f87f285548eec265192ffa80.jpg[/img]

[h1]Remote Play Together[/h1]
You can enjoy playing SUPERVERSE with your friends even if they are not in the same room by using Steam's [b]Remote Play Together[/b] feature. This way you can run the game on your computer and invite friends online to join the co-op multiplayer SUPERVERSE.

Here's a quick guide on how to invite your remote friend and play together:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/3032537193879549687

[h1]Introducing new spaceship[/h1]
We proudly present [b]Soko[/b], fast and agile, but still well armed and powerful, state of the art spacecraft.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/259e99e14f5689ea3c9b5eed1fdabba77d2a071b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Keyboard controls extended[/h1]
We have extended the keyboard controls scheme with additional keys for easier playing on some setups:
[list][*][b]SPACE[/b] key can be used for firing from the primary weapon, in addition to CTRL and ENTER.
[*][b]SHIFT[/b] key can be used for firing from the secondary weapon, besides ALT.
[*][b]PAUSE[/b] and ESC keys can pause the game, enter the in-game menu, or be used to navigate back in the menus.
[/list]

[h1]Other updates[/h1]
Update also brings improved stability and minor game balance changes. 

[b]FMOD Studio[/b] sound system has been updated to the latest version, which solves several crashes and bugs. This should resolve the issue where the game sounds went silent suddenly, but music and voices could still be heard. Please let us know if you experience such a situation again.

For more detailed changelog read below.

[h1][Update #4] 2019-12-17[/h1]
[b]Added[/b]
 • Local Co-op Multiplayer mode, up to 4 players.
 • New spaceship: Soko.

[b]Changed[/b]
 • FMOD & FMOD Studio updated to v1.10.18.
 • Crystal item recharges the energy of every ship to 100%.
 • Camera updates to support multiple players.

notes.title: Update #3: Adjustable video post-processing level
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/cc3132712b63c652cb4d6a76516fc53b8733f445.jpg[/img]

The new updated version of SUPERVERSE game is available. This version brings the following:

[h1][Update #3] 2019-12-09[/h1]
[b]Added[/b]
 • Option for adjusting the level of video post-processing added to [b]Settings > Video[/b] menu. This option is set to HIGH by default. Setting it to LOW disables motion-blur, depth of field and light shafts visual effects and improves the performance.

[b]Changed[/b]
 • Game content and difficulty balance slightly changed.

notes.title: Update #2: Support for integrated Intel graphics, Mac and Linux
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35079225/ab4c0f1278e1b3c308dbfa5b8ea766fd7a40f566.png[/img]

We are working continually on improving the game experience, fixing bugs and adding new capabilities to the game. Here's what we have prepared for the second update.

[h1]Integrated Intel graphics chip support[/h1]
We have resolved the issue that occurred on laptops without a discrete graphics chip (Nvidia or AMD GPU) but with an integrated Intel graphics. This update will enable most players with such laptops to run the game smoothly and without crashes.

Still, we recommend reducing the screen resolution on these laptops, in order to gain better performance and more fluid gameplay.
 
[h1]Linux support[/h1]
It has been confirmed that SUPERVERSE game can be played on Linux systems using [b]Steam Play[/b] (Proton).

You can contribute to ProtonDB and confirm if the game runs fine on your Linux system too: https://www.protondb.com/app/1056170

[h1]Mac support[/h1]
Although SUPERVERSE game does not support macOS natively, the game could have been played on Macs running Windows operating system using [b]Boot Camp[/b] since day one. 

This update allows the game to be played without any problems using [b]Parallels Desktop 15[/b] emulator as well. We have also managed to start the game in VMWare Fusion, but only partially for now.

[h1]What's coming next[/h1]
In the days ahead, we will publish the road-map of the features and functionalities we plan to introduce in the future. The first among those will be the introduction of local co-op multiplayer mode. 

For more detailed changelog read below:
[h1][Update #2] 2019-11-26[/h1]
[b]Added[/b]
 • The game can now be started on Mac using Parallels Desktop 15 emulator.

[b]Changed[/b]
 • Smoother camera behavior.

[b]Fixed[/b]
 • Fixed the problem where after setting music volume to 0% the music could still be heard.
 • Fixed the problem with memory consumption on PCs featuring integrated Intel GPU; resulting in improved stability and slightly better performance.

notes.title: The first update
notes.content:
Since releasing the SUPERVERSE game into Early Access, we have been continuously working on improving some of the aspects of the game in order to streamline the experience for the majority of the players.

This is just the first among many steps, many updates yet to be released.

For the detailed overview of what's new read more below:

[h1][Update #1] 2019-11-15 changelog:[/h1]
[b]Added[/b]
- On laptops featuring both integrated and discrete graphics chip the game will automatically try to use a discrete Nvidia or AMD GPU.

[b]Changed[/b]
- Menu navigation has been improved, closing in-game menu and resuming the game as well as returning to previous menus using START / OPTION buttons is now possible.
- Menu and spaceship selection using analog controller has been improved, it is less sensitive now.
- Content changes made in the first universe.
- Game difficulty balance changed.
- Text changes.
